title: Step response of y_t = 0.8y_{t−1} + 2u_{t−1}
caption: Fed a unit step, the model's output creeps from 0 towards 10 as 10(1 − 0.8^t): the first step gives 2, and the DC gain is b/(1 − a) = 2/0.2 = 10.
alt: A curve rising from 0 by 2 at t = 1 and levelling off at 10, with a dashed line at 10.
description: The model has a₁ = −0.8 and b₁ = 2.
A unit step gives y₁ = 2, y₂ = 3.6, … following 10(1 − 0.8^t).
At steady state y = 0.8y + 2u, so the DC gain is 2/0.2 = 10.

checks.name: the output approaches the DC gain 10
